title: Android release build: emulator verification of the user-facing build
checklist: build the release variant (assembleRelease), note the APK name and signing state, verify embedded official-web + spike assets inside it
sign the unsigned APK locally with the debug keystore for verification only, and record that this is not the shipped artifact's state
plain launch (no extras, nothing staged) reaches the official DSH Web UI: screenshot + ZERO dsh.spike.log records, ZERO level:debug, ZERO level:info, no verdict text, no gateway-audit lines
the release build REFUSES an E2E drive by name (--ez dsh.llm true) rather than silently no-op-ing
contrast: dsh-android-harness (assembleDebug) on the same plain launch still emits the full E2E stream
evidence committed under hosts/android/artifacts/release-logging/ with a re-runnable run.sh (non-zero exit on violation) and MANIFEST.md
gov run green, PR opened and merged

void.reason: Android release verification CLOSED and merged (PR #87, squash 38b815d): the user-facing release build was verified on a real emulator (AVD pixel, API 35 arm64, emulator-5554), which is exactly the gap PR #83 recorded as 'static verification only (no emulator available)'. Deliverables in the merged PR: hosts/android/artifacts/release-logging/ (run.sh that re-runs and asserts with exit non-zero on violation, MANIFEST.md mapping every assertion to a file, raw logcat captures for both variants, the screenshots, apk-release-contents.txt, origin-release.txt, signing.txt, apk-release-listing.txt) + an Agent Note under .agents/notes/implemented/testing/ + a surprise record (sig the-release-strip-covers). Measured: assembleRelease ships app-release-unsigned.apk (apksigner: DOES NOT VERIFY) embedding 89 assets/official-web/ + 129 assets/web-plugins/ + 254 assets/spike/ entries; a plain launch renders the official DSH Web UI with 0 dsh.spike.log records / 0 level:debug / 0 level:info / 0 verdict text / 0 gateway-audit lines against the harness's 204 records (168 debug, 36 info, ALL PASS); --ez dsh.llm true is refused BY NAME; the local debug-keystore signing is named as a verification-only step in MANIFEST.md and signing.txt. CI: gates + android-e2e both green. Void rather than close because close stamps a receipt the task gate then rejects (#329/#339) -- the plane's standing dead-end, followed per the precedent note; the PR is the audit trail.
